name: Dazzlebirds Users Import Export For WooCommerce
author: WP SmartStore

sections.description:
Customer data is one of the most valuable assets of any WooCommerce business. When you are moving to a new store, merging customer records, or maintaining user databases and backups, accurate customer data is essential.

Dazzlebirds Users Import Export for WooCommerce is built to manage WordPress users and WooCommerce customers using a systematic CSV file process. As customer databases grow, manually managing large volumes of records across multiple websites and environments becomes difficult. Designed for store owners, agencies, developers, and eCommerce businesses, the plugin makes migration, user data transfer, and administration simple and reliable — giving you greater control over customer and user data as your store’s operational needs grow.

Key Features

  • Import WooCommerce customers from CSV files.
  • Export WooCommerce customers to CSV for backups, migrations, and customer data management.
  • Import WordPress users from CSV files.
  • Export WordPress users to CSV for reporting and data transfers.
  • Import and export WooCommerce billing address information.
  • Import and export WooCommerce shipping address information.
  • Filter user exports by customer roles and user roles.
  • Map CSV columns with the correct WordPress and WooCommerce user fields before import.
  • Automatically create new user accounts during import.
  • Save reusable import and export templates for future user imports, exports, and migration tasks.
  • Process large user and customer databases in batches for smoother data handling.
  • Track import and export progress throughout long-running operations.
  • View detailed execution logs for import and export activities.
  • Track previous imports and exports with history records.
  • Configure CSV delimiters including comma, semicolon, tab, pipe, and custom delimiters.
  • Manage WooCommerce customer and WordPress user data with greater accuracy and less manual work.

What Makes Dazzlebirds Users Import Export for WooCommerce Different?

Every WooCommerce store runs on its users — customers, account holders, and subscriber registrations — which all need to be correct, up-to-date, and easy to manage. Dazzlebirds Users Import Export for WooCommerce gives store owners and administrators an automated approach to bulk customer onboarding, user account management, site migrations, and database maintenance — without manually managing records one by one or risking data errors.

What You Can Manage With This Plugin

  • WooCommerce Customer Import — Import WooCommerce customers from CSV files.
  • WooCommerce Customer Export — Export WooCommerce customers to CSV for backups, migrations, and customer data management.
  • WordPress User Import — Import WordPress users from CSV files.
  • WordPress User Export — Export WordPress users to CSV for reporting and data transfers.
  • Billing Address Data — Import and export WooCommerce billing address information.
  • Shipping Address Data — Import and export WooCommerce shipping address information.
  • Role-Based Export Filters — Filter user exports by customer roles and user roles.
  • CSV Column Mapping — Map CSV columns with the correct WordPress and WooCommerce user fields before import.
  • New User Account Creation — Automatically create new user accounts during import.
  • Reusable Templates — Save reusable import and export templates for future user imports, exports, and migration tasks.
  • Batch Processing — Process large user and customer databases in batches for smoother data handling.
  • Progress Tracking — Track import and export progress throughout long-running operations.
  • Execution Logs — View detailed execution logs for import and export activities.
  • Import/Export History — Track previous imports and exports with history records.
  • CSV Delimiter Settings — Configure CSV delimiters, including comma, semicolon, tab, pipe, and custom delimiters.
  • User Data Management — Manage WooCommerce customer and WordPress user data with greater accuracy and less manual work.

User and Customer Data You Can Manage

Customer data is more than names and email addresses. WooCommerce records customer data that can include account information, billing and shipping addresses, user roles, and other WordPress or WooCommerce fields. These fields need to remain accurate when data is transferred, backed up, or bulk updated.

Dazzlebirds Users Import Export for WooCommerce allows store owners, developers, and agencies to manage that data without having to edit each user record manually. Import and export WooCommerce customers, WordPress users, billing address details, shipping address details, and role-based user information using a controlled CSV workflow.

This is convenient if customer records need to be moved between websites, archived for later use, or reviewed during store maintenance. Thanks to features like column mapping, batch processing, reusable templates, progress tracking, execution logs, and import/export history, the plugin provides a more transparent way for teams to manage WooCommerce customer and WordPress user data with less manual work.

How Businesses Use This Plugin

  • WooCommerce customer migrations.
  • WordPress user migrations.
  • Customer database backups and recovery.
  • Bulk user imports and exports.
  • Customer data transfers between websites.
  • Managing WooCommerce billing and shipping information.
  • User onboarding and account management.
  • Development and staging environment synchronization.
  • Agencies managing multiple WordPress and WooCommerce websites.
  • Ongoing customer and user data maintenance.

Keep Customer and User Data Consistent During Every Transfer

When you move, back up, or update customer and user records in bulk, handle the data carefully. A WooCommerce customer profile contains account details, billing information, shipping information, and user role information. A mismatch in any of these fields at import or export time makes the customer database less trustworthy and harder to manage going forward.

Dazzlebirds Users Import Export for WooCommerce gives store owners a controlled way to manage WooCommerce customers and WordPress users through CSV files. Before importing, you can map CSV columns to the appropriate WordPress and WooCommerce user fields, generate new user accounts during import, and filter exported records by customer or user role for a more targeted file.

The plugin provides more control for repeated user data tasks via reusable templates, batch processing, progress tracking, execution logs, import/export history, and CSV delimiter settings — a reliable way for store owners, developers, and agencies to manage customer backups, user migrations, bulk imports, and ongoing customer data management without manually checking each record.

Premium Version Features

  • Background Import: Continue import operations in the background, even after closing the browser window.
  • Bundle Import & Export: Import and export products, orders, customers, coupons, reviews, categories, and tags in a single operation.
  • Meta Fields Support: Support ACF fields and custom meta fields with advanced field mapping.
  • Excel, XML, CSV, and TSV Support: Import and export data using Excel (.xlsx), XML, CSV, and TSV file formats.
  • Google Sheets Integration: Connect Google Sheets and sync data directly from your spreadsheets.
  • Scheduled Import & Export: Schedule imports and exports to run automatically at specified times.
  • FTP, SFTP, and URL Import: Import files directly from FTP, SFTP, and remote URLs.
  • Advanced Filters & Customization: Apply advanced filters and control how duplicate records are handled during import and export.

How to Export WooCommerce Customers & WordPress Users?

Exporting customers from WooCommerce and WordPress users is important for backing up your customer database during site migrations, for reporting, and for user management operations. Downloading customer and user data in CSV format makes it easier to analyze records, retain account data, and migrate data between WordPress and WooCommerce sites.

Dazzlebirds Users Import Export for WooCommerce exports customer and user data including billing addresses, shipping addresses, user roles, and account data. With flexible export options, you can create user-specific datasets that streamline customer and user management.

To export, activate the plugin, confirm WooCommerce is installed and active, then go to WC Data Manager → Export in the WordPress admin menu.

How to Import WooCommerce Customers & WordPress Users?

Dazzlebirds Users Import Export for WooCommerce lets you import customer details such as billing addresses, shipping addresses, user roles, and account information in bulk — creating new user accounts automatically and reducing the effort required to manually create records. The column mapping interface helps you map CSV data to the relevant WordPress and WooCommerce user fields accurately.

To import, activate the plugin, confirm WooCommerce is installed and active, then go to WC Data Manager → Import in the WordPress admin menu.

Recommended WP SmartStore Plugins

  • Dazzlebirds Products Import Export for WooCommerce — Easily import, export, migrate, and update WooCommerce products, categories, tags, reviews, images, variations, and catalog data. https://wordpress.org/plugins/dazzlebirds-products-import-export-for-woocommerce/
  • Dazzlebirds Orders Import Export for WooCommerce — Easily import, export, filter, and manage WooCommerce orders and coupons for backups, reports, and store migration. https://wordpress.org/plugins/dazzlebirds-orders-import-export-for-woocommerce/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/dazzlebirds-users-import-export-for-woocommerce, or install directly through the WordPress plugin screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in your WordPress admin.
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and active (WooCommerce 5.0 or higher required).
  4. Navigate to WC Data Manager in the WordPress admin menu, then select the Import or Export tab to begin.
sections.faq:
How do I export users to CSV?

Go to WC Data Manager → Export, select Users/Customers as the post type, apply any filters (role, date range, specific columns), and click Export. The file is generated in batches and available for download from the history table.

How do I import users from a CSV file?

Go to WC Data Manager → Import, select Users/Customers, upload your CSV file, and map columns to the correct WordPress user fields and WooCommerce billing/shipping address fields using the column mapping UI. Click Run Import to start. Use Quick Import for one-click re-imports of previously exported files.

Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce 5.0 or higher must be installed and active. WooCommerce billing and shipping address fields are WooCommerce-specific and require an active installation.

Can I import and export WordPress users who are not WooCommerce customers?

Yes. Any WordPress user — Administrator, Editor, Author, Subscriber, Customer, Shop Manager, or any custom role — can be imported and exported. The plugin is not limited to WooCommerce customers.

What file formats and delimiters are supported?

CSV is the supported format for both import and export. The delimiter is selectable per operation: comma (default), semicolon, tab, pipe, or a custom character of your choice.

Is there a limit on how many users can be imported or exported?

No hard limit. Processing runs in configurable batches, so even stores with tens of thousands of users can complete operations without PHP timeouts or memory errors.

Will importing overwrite existing users?

If an imported user’s ID, username, or email matches an existing account, that account will be updated. A confirmation popup reminds you to create a backup before every import runs.

Can I save my column-mapping setup for future imports?

Yes. After mapping columns during an advanced import, you can save the configuration as a named template and reuse it for future import operations.

Can I use this plugin to migrate customers between stores?

Yes. Export from the source store, then import the CSV into the destination store. The plugin preserves billing addresses, shipping addresses, roles, and user meta throughout the migration.

Can I import products, orders, coupons, or reviews with this plugin?

No. This plugin handles users and customers only. For other WooCommerce entities, please install the matching plugins in the Dazzlebirds Import Export suite.

Where can I view past import and export operations?

The History tab inside WC Data Manager shows a full log of every operation, including status, record counts, error details, and a download link for previously exported files.

Can I include custom user meta fields in an export?

Yes. Advanced Export lets you select standard user profile fields, WooCommerce billing and shipping address fields, custom meta fields, and hidden (underscore-prefixed) meta fields.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • Import and export WooCommerce customers and WordPress users with billing address, shipping address, roles, and custom metadata support.
  • Role filtering, date-range filtering, custom meta inclusion, and hidden meta toggle on export.
  • Batched processing engine with configurable batch size.
  • Import/export history tracking with optional auto-delete and downloadable files.
  • Save and reuse import column-mapping templates.
  • Backup-before-import confirmation popup.
  • Flexible CSV delimiter support: comma, semicolon, tab, pipe, or custom character.
